definitions.gloss: welcoming new members; welcome event or party for newcomers
definitions.explanation: Short for {新入生歓迎|しんにゅうせいかんげい} or {新人歓迎|しんじんかんげい}: the events, parties and recruiting held in spring to welcome new students into a university club, or new employees into a workplace. A casual word, very common among students.

examples.english: A welcome party for new members.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦サークル→サークル：10933_saakuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新歓|しんかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: April is busy with club events to welcome new students.

examples.japanese: {新歓|しんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦キャンパス→キャンパス：10822_kyanpasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ビラ→ビラ：11240_bira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いっぱい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When the new-student welcome season comes, the campus fills with students handing out flyers.

notes:
From ⟦{新入生|しんにゅうせい}→新入生：03073_shinnyuusei⟧ (new student) or ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧ (newcomer) + ⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧ (welcome). Japanese universities start in April, so {新歓|しんかん} is a spring word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新歓|しんかん}コンパ / {新歓|しんかん}⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧: welcome drinking party
- {新歓|しんかん}⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧: welcome event
- {新歓|しんかん}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: the recruiting and welcome period

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{歓迎会|かんげいかい}→歓迎会：15791_kangeikai⟧: welcome party (general word)
- ⟦{歓送迎会|かんそうげいかい}→歓送迎会：30247_kansougeikai⟧: party to see off leavers and welcome newcomers (at work)
